_comment: Mods known to need Minecraft's OpenGL backend (they build OpenGL backend objects themselves, so the JVM aborts on Metal).
Nativium asks the player before start-up instead of crashing (see de.nprmedia.nativium.compat.OpenGlRequirements).
nativiumCompat: Fabric version predicate of the mod versions that Nativium's own compatibility code runs on Metal;
those versions are not asked about. Mods not listed here are still caught by the scan heuristic
nativiumGl: "all" routes every class of the mod through nativium-gl while the compatibility code applies.

mods.name: Physics Mod
mods.reason: builds Minecraft's OpenGL backend objects (GlSampler, GlTexture, GlDevice) on every non-Vulkan device
